description: The components scope of Content first: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: components.roles
answers.why: Readers need sections, navigation and little else.

answers.question: components.count
answers.why: Actions are rare, so the components today's pages use cover them.

answers.question: components.definition
answers.why: A component joins only when reading needs it.

answers.question: components.values
answers.why: Pages stay calm when a component changes only with its meaning.

answers.question: components.lands
answers.why: Components sit inside and around articles.

usage.use: plain text, a link or a heading
usage.not: a new component for one article
usage.why: Readers come for the words; extra parts pull the eye away from them.
